description:
RESTORE `dev` TO A PROMOTED VERSION. Puts the files of a previous promoted version (an exact promoted-version tag) back on `dev` as a new commit on top of it, history preserved, and deploys nothing by itself. Production is never rolled back directly (that would put it on a state dev never had): restore, try it on dev, then ateam_github_promote.

Workflow: 1) ateam_github_list_versions (find a prod-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN tag) → 2) ateam_github_rollback(target: '<that tag>') → 3) ateam_build_and_run to try it → 4) ateam_github_promote. Solutions older than 2026-05-19 may also carry retired safe-* tags; rollback accepts those too.

target.description: A prod-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN tag (an exact promoted version) to restore dev to. Use ateam_github_list_versions to find the tags. Solutions older than 2026-05-19 may also carry retired safe-* tags; rollback accepts those too.

name: ateam_github_rollback
